question: Where can I find café positioned within 60 kilometers along the path to Tribeca Island Nature Reserve, Egg Harbor Township, NJ from Institute of Contemporary Art, Philadelphia, PA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Institute of Contemporary Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Philadelphia%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT P.geometry FROM parks AS P WHERE P.park_name ILIKE '%Tribeca Island Nature Reserve%' AND ST_Intersects(P.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Egg Harbor Township%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 60000 -- 60 kilometers in meters ) );
